name: Sandstorm
desc: Wind-driven grit blowing across the frame — wind-stretched dust sheets scroll in parallax at three depths while saltating grains hop and streak downwind, and a soft gust front sweeps through every so often and briefly swallows the scene; set wind negative to blow the other way.

energy.doc: storm force — sheet opacity, streak length, gust punch

density.doc: grain count + how tightly the storm hugs the core

scale.doc: sheet + grain size vs design size

wind.doc: wind direction and strength (negative blows left)

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — drop toward 0.2 to keep the scene readable through it

hue.doc: sand hue (34 ochre, 14 rust/mars, 48 pale dune)

x.doc: storm core X — grains thin out away from it

y.doc: storm core Y — push to 0.9 for a ground-hugging blow

style.doc: aesthetic: hard ridged ochre grit in harsh sun / soft near-monochrome sepia mass, heavy occlusion / airflow as a banded schlieren density field, no grains at all / dark quartz grains throwing hard specular glints

act.doc: dramaturgy: steady blow / fronts pulse hard with the musical arc / slowly builds to near-total occlusion and clears again
